question.text: If $\mathrm{T}=2 \pi \sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{ML}^{3}}{3 \mathrm{Yq}}}$ then find the dimensions of q. Where $\mathrm{T}$ is the time period of bar of mass $\mathrm{M}$ length $\mathrm{L}$ and Young modulus $\mathrm{Y}$.

solution.text:
$\mathrm{T}=2 \pi \sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{ML}^{3}}{3 \mathrm{Yq}}},$ writing dimensions of both
the sides, we get $[\mathrm{T}]=\left[\frac{\mathrm{ML}^{3}}{\mathrm{ML}^{-1} \mathrm{~T}^{-2} \mathrm{q}}\right]^{1 / 2}$
or $\quad q=\left[L^{4}\right]$
